purpose: Teach: 酵母/菜園/人影/たまらなく/敷き/知ったかぶる/恥じ/押せ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、パン作りの、本気で、絶対、酵母、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、興味あるわ
lines.en: Aoi, you're genuinely fascinated by bread-making, aren't you — especially the yeast science of it all.
lines.style: Warm, admiring observation. Leans in with genuine curiosity. Soft emphasis on Aoi's name like a gentle confirmation. Unhurried pace, almost wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、家庭、絶対、菜園、絶対、で、絶対、お野菜、絶対、育ててるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and you're really serious about growing vegetables in your home garden too.
lines.style: Animated agreement, building energy. Light brightness on the acknowledgment. Speaking as if sharing in something genuine and tangible. Open, inclusive tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夜の道、本気で、絶対、人影、絶対、見えると、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、安心するわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, there's something comforting about seeing someone on the street at night — it settles something in you.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Spoken softly, like sharing a quiet observation. Gentle pause before and after. Vulnerable but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、たまらなく、絶対、お祖母さまの、絶対、お味噌汁、絶対、食べたい時があるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know what you mean — sometimes I just desperately want my grandmother's miso soup.
lines.style: Wistful and tender. Voice softens on the admission. A small, knowing laugh underneath. Intimate without being loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の床に、絶対、敷きマット、絶対、新しくしたのね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You replaced the floor mats at the café, didn't you — I really noticed that attention to detail.
lines.style: Genuine praise, steady and sincere. Specific appreciation in the voice — not flattering, but truly seeing. Warm and direct.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様に、本気で、絶対、知ったかぶる、絶対、ような、絶対、態度、絶対、葵、絶対、しないよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You never act like you know everything when talking with customers — you're genuine with them.
lines.style: Earnest and steady. Speaking with conviction but no edge. Simple, direct delivery. Like stating something true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お料理の失敗、絶対、恥じる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、お客様に、絶対、新作試食、絶対、お願いしてるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You don't hesitate to ask customers to try your new dishes, even when they're experimental — you have real courage about that.
lines.style: Admiring recognition. Warm emphasis on the vulnerability it takes. Not loud, but clear about what she's seeing. Respectful tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、メニュー、絶対、押せば、絶対、注文できる、絶対、システム、絶対、入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've installed a whole system where people can order just by pressing a button for the new menu items — that's smart thinking.
lines.style: Animated, affirming close. Brightness on the innovation. Quick, enthusiastic but grounded. Like celebrating something real and practical.
